Up. 3. 13. 7</ls>; <ls>U. 4. 18</ls>. .²3 Lightning. .²4 A heavenly body. .²5 A heavenly body, a luminary (planet, star <ab>&c.</ab>); ज्योतिर्भिरुद्यद्भिरिव त्रियामा <ls>Ku. 7. 21</ls>; <ls>Bg. 10. 21</ls>; <ls>H. 1. 21</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 19</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 6</ls>. .²6 Brightness of the sky, day-light (<ab>opp.</ab> तमस्). .²7 The sun and moon (dual). .²8 Light as the divine principle of life, intelligence. .²9 The science of the course of heavenly bodies; astronomy. See ज्योतिष. .²10 The faculty of seeing. .²11 The celestial world. .²12 A Cow; <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 3. 49</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 The sun. .²2 Fire; ज्योतिष्कल्पोरुकेशरः (मारुतिः) <ls>Bk. 9. 60</ls>. .²8 An epithet of Viṣṇu.
